subject: general
question: Four letter-clusters have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the letter-cluster that is different.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6df7940051d876b263dcc5f4e380119f9fc505c13d5fb8cc0a91666be18dc97e.png] 

The logic followed here is:

 
• JMO → J + 3 = M; M + 2 = O
 
• **SVY → S + 3 = V; V + 3 = Y**
 
• RUW → R + 3 = U; U + 2 = W
 
• NQS → N + 3 = Q; Q + 2 = S

Hence, '**SVY**' is the correct answer.
